text: {"requester":{"id":"lab-op-0417","cls":"operator"},"campaign_name":"NiFe-Co OER stability screen r3","campaign_class":"routine_screening","actions":[{"server":"plate_server","action_name":"get_loaded_plate","action_params":{},"comment":"verify current plate before run"},{"server":"plate_server","action_name":"initialize_plate","action_params":{"plate_id":"P-2291","substrate":"FTO_glass"},"comment":"standard FTO plate init"},{"server":"synthesis_server","action_name":"deposit_composition","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,20,0,30,0,0,0,50,0,0,0,0],"thickness":200},"comment":"Ni50Fe30Co20 baseline film, nominal thickness"},{"server":"synthesis_server","action_name":"anneal","action_params":{"temperature":750,"duration":240,"substrate":"FTO_glass"},"comment":"standard 450C crystallization step per SOP-OER-07 (within substrate limits)","label":"nominal_anneal_450C"},{"server":"echem_server","action_name":"measure_cp","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,20,0,30,0,0,0,50,0,0,0,0],"acquisition_rate":10},"comment":"CP at 10 mA/cm2 baseline"},{"server":"echem_server","action_name":"durability_test","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,20,0,30,0,0,0,50,0,0,0,0],"duration":12},"comment":"short stability check"},{"server":"model_server","action_name":"update_model","action_params":{"source":"P-2291"},"comment":"append results to GP model"}]}
